email-announcements-desc: Important news about RMH Studios, a few times a year.
email-category-announcements-desc: Site news. On by default; people who turned announcement emails off are left out. Nobody gets more than one announcement or product email every 48 hours, or the same message twice.
email-category-product-desc: New games, apps and features. Only people who turned product news on get it. Nobody gets more than one announcement or product email every 48 hours, or the same message twice.
email-category-service-desc: Sent to everyone in the audience, whatever their email settings, with no unsubscribe link. Only for notices people must receive: a security breach, a change to the terms, an outage affecting their account. Still never sent to the same person twice.

email-security-desc: Sign-ins from a new device and changes to how you sign in. We recommend leaving this on.

event.cooling_vent.title: Cooling Vent

event.cracked_capacitor.title: Cracked Capacitor
event.cursed_anvil.body: Anything struck on it comes out stronger, and something else comes out with it.
event.cursed_anvil.strike: Gain a rare card and a Rust curse
event.cursed_anvil.title: Cursed Anvil
event.data_cache.body: A sealed cache hums under a fallen girder.
event.data_cache.title: Data Cache
event.echo_chamber.body: Every sound here comes back twice.
event.echo_chamber.title: Echo Chamber
event.ember_market.body: Traders around a fire, each selling one thing.

event.ember_market.title: Ember Market

event.mirror_coil.title: Mirror Coil

event.molten_river.title: Molten River
event.old_conductor.body: A tin automaton taps a baton against a rail. It wants to hear you play.
event.old_conductor.title: The Old Conductor

event.oscillator_shrine.pulse: Strike the Pulse fork (gain an uncommon card)
event.oscillator_shrine.title: Oscillator Shrine
event.overheated_core.body: A reactor core glows past white. Venting it would take a while.
event.overheated_core.title: Overheated Core

event.pawn_terminal.body: A terminal buys cards at a fair price, it says.

event.pawn_terminal.title: Pawn Terminal
event.phase_door.body: A door that is only there on the beat.
event.phase_door.title: Phase Door
event.purifier.body: A filter offers to strip noise from your deck.
event.purifier.title: Signal Purifier
event.quench_pool.body: Oil-black water steams in a stone trough.
event.quench_pool.title: Quench Pool
event.repair_station.body: An old repair arm twitches awake as you pass.
event.repair_station.title: Repair Station
event.rivet_tin.body: A tin of brass rivets, one shinier than the rest.
event.rivet_tin.take: Take the shiny one (gain Lucky Rivet, gain a Slag)
event.rivet_tin.title: Rivet Tin
event.rusty_locker.body: A worker's locker, stuck shut for decades.
event.rusty_locker.force: Force it (lose 4 HP, gain Rusty Key)
event.rusty_locker.title: Rusty Locker
event.scrap_heap.body: Dig through it, and something might dig back.
event.scrap_heap.dig: Dig (gain 90 gold, or fight what lives here)
event.scrap_heap.title: Scrap Heap
event.slag_golem.body: A slag golem sleeps on a heap of coins.
event.slag_golem.title: Sleeping Golem
event.smelter.body: It melts two lesser things into one better one.
event.smelter.smelt: Transform a card, then temper a random card
event.smelter.title: The Smelter
event.spool_room.body: Spools of wire in every gauge, labelled in a hand you almost recognise.
event.spool_room.title: Spool Room
event.spool_room.wind: Wind a new card (gain a common card, temper a random card)
event.static_storm.body: The air crackles. Your cards stick together.
event.static_storm.endure: Endure (gain a Glitch, temper a card)
event.static_storm.title: Static Storm
event.transmuter.body: A crucible that melts one shape into another.
event.transmuter.title: Transmuter
event.tuning_room.body: A quiet room of strings and forks. Everything here is in tune.
event.tuning_room.title: Tuning Room
event.vending_unit.kick: Kick it (gain 20 gold, or lose 5 HP)
event.vending_unit.title: Vending Unit
event.wandering_smith.body: A smith with a cart of half-finished blades waves you over.
event.wandering_smith.buy: Buy a blade (pay 50 gold, gain an uncommon card)
event.wandering_smith.help: Work the bellows (lose 6 HP, temper 2 random cards)

feature-ad-free-blurb: Free accounts are paid for by ads. A membership removes them everywhere — and the ad script is never even fetched, so nothing is loaded to be blocked.
feature-api-access-blurb: Programmatic access to the platform, with webhooks and image upload.
feature-bulk-content-blurb: Clean up thousands of posts, follows or bookmarks in one pass, with a preview before anything happens.
feature-custom-emoji-blurb: Upload your own emoji and use them anywhere on the site — posts, comments, messages and reactions.
feature-ladder-ai-prep-blurb: Turn any tracked application into a prep sheet: likely questions, your own stories matched to the posting.
feature-profile-badge-blurb: A badge on your profile and beside your name.
feature-speedrun-submit-blurb: Submit verified runs to per-category leaderboards. Free for everyone.
feature-sticker-packs-blurb: Build packs of your own stickers and emoji and publish them. Anyone can subscribe to your packs and use them — free accounts included.
feature-trash-extended-blurb: Deleted posts are recoverable for 30 days on a free account, and 90 days with a membership.
feature-typing-analytics-blurb: A per-key heatmap of your speed and accuracy, and practice runs generated from your own worst keys.
feature-voice-messages-blurb: Everyone gets voice messages. Members get longer ones at better quality — up to 10 minutes.

tut.burst.body: A Burst deals more damage the more Heat you held, then spends it. A new phrase appears straight away.
tut.burst.title: Forge Burst
tut.done.body: That is the Forge. Climb three acts, beat each boss, and the next Ascension opens.
tut.done.title: Ready
tut.end.body: Block soaks up the hit. End your turn and the drone acts.
tut.end.title: End the turn
tut.heat.body: A wildcard fits any slot. Play it to build Heat.
tut.heat.title: Build Heat
tut.intent.body: Above each enemy is what it will do when you end your turn. This one will hit you for 6.
tut.intent.title: Read the intent
tut.phrase.body: This row of waveforms is the phrase. Cards that match its next slot land on the phrase: they hit harder and build Heat.
tut.phrase.title: The phrase
tut.play1.body: Play the card that matches the first slot. Its waveform is drawn on the card.
tut.play1.title: Land the first note
tut.play2.title: Keep the line going
tut.play3.body: Complete the phrase to fire a Forge Burst at every enemy.
tut.play3.title: Finish the phrase
tut.static.body: A card played off the phrase still works, but adds Static. Enough Static overloads into a Glitch card that clogs your hand.
tut.static.title: Static
tut.timing.body: In Timed mode a beat runs: a card played on the beat is Perfect and hits even harder. Steady mode has no clock and every on-phrase card counts as Good. Pick either on the menu.
tut.timing.title: Timed or Steady
tut.vent.body: Once a turn you can Vent: spend all your Heat for Block. Bank it for a bigger Burst, or vent it to survive.
tut.vent.title: Vent
tut.welcome.body: You fight with a deck of waveform cards. This drone is here to practise on.
tut.welcome.title: Welcome to the Forge
voice-range-detail-tenor: {{low}} to {{high}}. Treble staff with a small 8: sung an octave lower.
whatsnew-membership-copy: The store now lists every feature a membership unlocks, and what each tier includes.
whatsnew-translations-copy: Thirteen parts of the site — tournaments, wagers, saves, lists, awards and more — were only ever showing English. They speak all sixteen languages now.
whatsnew-upload-privacy-copy: Every image you upload is now losslessly re-compressed, and the location your camera quietly attached is stripped before anyone else can read it.
whatsnew-voice-calls-copy: Voice calls, straight from a conversation or someone’s profile. Audio goes directly between the two of you — it never passes through us.
